install_cmds: python -c "import torch, numpy, PIL; assert torch.__version__.split('+')[0] == '2.4.1'; print('image-inpainting image dependencies ready')"

data_deps.name: image_inpainting_places365_fullres_v1
data_deps.description: Pinned full-resolution image-inpainting artifact derived from every JPEG in the canonical Places365-Standard val_256 archive (SHA-256 24b4e639ef12a0012af525bc4cb443e4ab4aaea8369a1fb009b70e4a4aad5d48). A deterministic disjoint split uses 32,000 native 256x256 real images for optimization and 4,500 for evaluation. The artifact stores canonical manifests plus per-file byte counts and SHA-256 digests; the verifier recomputes them before training. This is a research-scale proxy, not a claim to reproduce the larger Places2 training corpus.
